## Setup

### Packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# check if need both tidyverse and ggplot2
# janitor and DataExplorer are good for data wrangling 
packages = c("tidyverse", "janitor", "DataExplorer", "ggplot2")


packageCheck = function(x) {
    if (!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
      library(x, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }

## Now load or install & load all
loadPacks<-lapply(packages, packageCheck)
```

### Versions of things used

## Data Setup

### Load in data and save to raw data files

```{r}
rawCovar <- read.csv(file="GSE85307_covar-1.csv", sep = ",")
rawGeneExp <- read.csv(file="GSE85307_geneExpression.csv", sep = ",")
rawGeneNames <- read.csv(file="GSE85307_geneNames.csv", sep = ",")
```

### Confirm Data Appears as Expected and examine setup

```{r}
introduce(rawCovar)
head(rawCovar)

introduce(rawGeneExp)
head(rawGeneExp)

introduce(rawGeneNames)
head(rawGeneNames)
```

covariate data: subjectID, geoID, mat_age_yrs, preg_preeclamspia, delivery_gestAge_wks, mat_BMI, mat_vitD, mat_asthma, sampleCollection_gestAge_wks, batch_Microarray

*I'm definitely interested in how asthma interacts here*
Define new data frames from the raw data frames that we can manipulate without having to re-import the original data frames every time
```{r}
covar <- rawCovar
geneExp <- rawGeneExp
geneNames <- rawGeneNames

view(covar)
view(geneExp)
view(geneNames)
```

Cleaning data
```{r}
# covar has lots of metadata in the values spaces. clean that 
cleanCovar <- covar %>%
  separate(col="mat_age_yrs", into = c(NA, "mat_age_yrs"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="preg_preeclampsia", into = c(NA, "preg_preeclampsia"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="delivery_gestAge_wks", into = c(NA, "preg_preeclampsia"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="sampleCollection_gestAge_wks", into = c(NA, "gest_weeks"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="batch_Microarray", into = c(NA, "batch_Microarray"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="mat_BMI", into = c(NA, "mat_BMI"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="mat_vitD", into = c(NA, "mat_vitD"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE) %>%
  separate(col="mat_asthma", into = c(NA, "mat_asthma"), sep = "\\ ", convert = TRUE)

# some pivot_longer situations 

```
